notes.title: THE AMAZING AMERICAN CIRCUS WITH A RELEASE DATE, BETA TESTS AND TRAILER
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

We have already informed you about the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433860/The_Amazing_American_Circus/]The Amazing American Circus game[/url]. It is a unique game blending adventure set in 19th Century USA with a creative approach to card game mechanics. We really hope you guys will find The Amazing American Circus interesting!!! 

We are pleased to announce that The Amazing American Circus will hit PC and consoles on[b] August 12[/b] this year but that we will also like to share the new trailer and to let you know about upcoming beta tests for this game. 

First of all, please check the new trailer introducing the story of the game:

[previewyoutube=Pr4orTHO_as;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]BETA TESTS[/b]

Tomorrow ([b]May 7[/b]) Klabater will start the initial beta testing phase of the game. The players who supported the game during the successful Kickstarter campaign will get to play it first. 

Buuut… on [b]May 20[/b], the open beta tests will begin, which will be carried out with the help of the [b]Steam Playtest[/b] mechanics - details will be provided soon (it is worth following the information appearing on the official [url=https://discord.gg/zJxgnMguvY]The Amazing American Circus Discord channel[/url]). Players will be able to test fragments of the first of the four regions available in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26893929/4208383bb96c7ddb2d5188a58566998f3164d164.jpg[/img]

Below is a planned map of the development of Klabater's flagship title for 2021:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26893929/0cbd1131905fd50c83d51dc32c5f73aa5f9363de.jpg[/img]

The Amazing American Circus is a blend of a Slay the Spire-style card game with Tycoon and simulation mechanics, as well as thoughtful resource management. Manage not only your artists but the entire circus camp. How you expand your circus depends only on you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26893929/a58ddde420b6d317e561091ca4522ed4bdf67a7e.jpg[/img]

What The Amazing American Circus has to offer?:

🎪 Become a legend! Save a run-down circus, gather a troupe of performers, and dare to defy the greatest showman on earth - P.T Barnum himself.
🎪 Recruit and train over 15 different types of circus artists
🎪 Take part in exciting battles on the circus arena using the beautifully illustrated collectible cards
🎪 Upgrade your circus caravan thanks to different types of wagons offering over 100 possible modifications
🎪 Meet both historical and fictional characters deeply embedded in American folklore, such as John D. Rockefeller, Susan B. Anthony, or Nikola Tesla
🎪 Immerse yourself in a story taking place during the turbulent era of the fading Wild West and enter the beautiful and dark world of Native American folklore and the immigrant populace
🎪 Listen to a unique soundtrack inspired by classic circus music and American country & folk

[b]The Amazing American Circus will be released on August 12, 2021[/b]!

notes.title: Hey, what's up with the release date?
notes.notes:
Well, 
as you might have noticed, we're not all up and running yet. We've had a minor technical snafu which should be resolved soon. We're talking a matter of hours at best (or a couple days at worst) but no more than that, so we really do mean "SOON" here. 

[h1]Hopefully we'll be live within the next 24hrs and in the meantime please wishlist Apocalipsis - that way you'll know we're up as soon as it happens![/h1]
